description:
"Invoke your expertise in anatomy and enemy behavior to detect stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff5|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. 

While active, increases the damage of your Stamina costing Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff25|r%.

While slotted you gain Major Savagery and Prophecy, increasing your Weapon and Spell Critical rating by |cffffff2629|r."
